detector.qualification: Automatic EUV candidate mask; detector and forecast skill not certified.

notes: Automatic multi-passband low-intensity candidate mask, not CHIMERA or a manually validated CH catalogue.
AIA and HMI use observed WCS, observer position and actual timestamps, including TAI conversion.
Polarity is independent per core and component; unknown is not quiet or neutral.
No trained forecast coefficients, local Bz prediction, source-to-Earth connectivity certification or Dst-to-G conversion.
